# deepseek-mcp-server 1.0.0

Repository: https://github.com/DMontgomery40/deepseek-mcp-server
MCP registry name: io.github.DMontgomery40/deepseek
npm package: deepseek-mcp-server
Runtime: Node.js 20+, TypeScript ESM

## Purpose

This package is an MCP server for DeepSeek V4.1 Flash. The default model is
deepseek-flash. It supports text and visual input, Chat Completions, Responses,
FIM completion, the Files API, model listing, balance checks, and bounded
process-local conversation memory.

Multimodal support is visual input only. The server does not generate images,
video, or audio.

## DeepSeek model state on 2026-09-10

- deepseek-flash is the canonical V4.1 Flash model.
- deepseek-v4-flash and deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp are temporary aliases.
- DeepSeek announced that deepseek-v4-pro will begin serving V4.1 Flash on
  2026-09-14 until V4.1 Pro is released.
- DeepSeek documents 1M context and up to 384K output for deepseek-flash.

Always prefer live list_models output when model availability matters.

## MCP protocol

The server uses the stable @modelcontextprotocol v2 split packages.

- HTTP negotiates MCP 2026-07-28.
- HTTP retains stateless 2025-era compatibility.
- Stdio selects the protocol era from the opening exchange.
- Static discovery and list results use one-hour public cache hints.
- Dynamic resource lists, runtime data, and conversations remain private and
  short-lived or uncached.
- MCP_HTTP_STATEFUL_SESSION no longer exists.
- conversation_id is explicit application state, not transport session state.

## Tools

chat_completion
  DeepSeek Chat Completions. Accepts message or messages. User/tool content may
  include text, image_url, or file parts. Images can use HTTP(S), supported
  base64 data URLs, inline file_data, or DeepSeek file_id references. Supports
  thinking, reasoning effort, tools, JSON output, stream aggregation, and
  optional conversation_id memory.

create_response
  Stateless DeepSeek Responses call. Accepts text and input_image parts using
  image_url or file_id. Supports reasoning, function and custom tools, web
  search, structured output, and semantic stream aggregation.

completion
  FIM completion through /beta/completions.

list_models
  Reads the live /models endpoint.

get_user_balance
  Reads /user/balance.

upload_file
  Uploads raw base64 or a JPEG, PNG, GIF, or WebP data URL to /files with
  purpose=user_data. Decoded uploads are limited to 64 MiB. Returns a reusable
  file-api-* ID. Local paths are rejected. Optional expires_after_seconds range:
  3600 to 2592000.

list_files
  Lists Files API metadata. Optional after, limit, order, and purpose filters.

retrieve_file
  Retrieves metadata for one file-api-* ID.

delete_file
  Deletes one file-api-* ID. This is destructive.

reset_conversation
  Clears one process-local conversation ID.

list_conversations
  Lists process-local conversation IDs.

Every tool has an output schema and MCP behavior annotations. Generation tools
omit the raw provider payload unless include_raw_response=true.

## Visual argument shapes

Chat URL:

{
  "message": [
    {"type":"text","text":"Describe this image."},
    {"type":"image_url","image_url":{"url":"https://example.com/a.png","detail":"high"}}
  ]
}

Chat inline data:

{
  "message": [
    {"type":"text","text":"Read this image."},
    {"type":"file","file_data":"data:image/png;base64,...","filename":"a.png"}
  ]
}

Chat uploaded file:

{
  "message": [
    {"type":"text","text":"Read this image."},
    {"type":"file","file_id":"file-api-..."}
  ]
}

Responses uploaded file:

{
  "input": [{
    "role": "user",
    "content": [
      {"type":"input_text","text":"Describe this."},
      {"type":"input_image","file_id":"file-api-..."}
    ]
  }]
}

## Environment

Required:
DEEPSEEK_API_KEY

Optional:
DEEPSEEK_BASE_URL=https://api.deepseek.com
DEEPSEEK_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS=120000
DEEPSEEK_DEFAULT_MODEL=deepseek-flash
MCP_TRANSPORT=stdio
MCP_HTTP_HOST=127.0.0.1
MCP_HTTP_PORT=3001
MCP_HTTP_PATH=/mcp
MCP_HTTP_ALLOWED_ORIGINS=
CONVERSATION_MAX_MESSAGES=200

## Install

DEEPSEEK_API_KEY=... npx -y deepseek-mcp-server@1
